I’d lean **yes, if you feel curious—not because you feel you ought to go**. You’ve recently brought up your high-school debate team and AP economics, and you’ve said performing in *Grease* left you exhilarated; a reunion could be a nice chance to reconnect with that chapter and see who people have become. I don’t know what your high-school relationships were like, though, so that matters more than nostalgia alone.

You could make it low-pressure: arrange to go with someone you trust, plan to stay for just an hour, and give yourself permission to leave if it doesn’t feel good. If you’re mainly dreading it or expecting it to reopen painful stuff, skipping it—or meeting one person separately—would be just as valid.
